purpose: Teach: 和訳/恩給/エクササイズ/クオリア/メディカル/性器/転化/近親

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、英文学の和訳比較研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you focused your paper on comparative translation studies in English literature, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Interested but not intrusive. Natural pacing, genuine curiosity about the student's work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦後の恩給制度史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the history of postwar pension systems.
lines.style: Direct and clear, meeting the teacher's eye. Respectful but not deferential. Steady pacing, no flourish.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 高齢者向けエクササイズの効果を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered the effects of exercise programs designed for seniors, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful tone, as if considering what she's just heard. Slight pause before speaking. Genuinely reflecting on the student's research.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen

lines.en: Yes, I looked into the philosophical concept of qualia.
lines.style: Firm and clear. Slight emphasis on the final word. Speaking with quiet confidence about something intellectually demanding.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: メディカルツーリズムの研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Medical tourism was the focus of your research, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: sakura_teen

lines.en: Yes, I examined preventive medicine approaches to genital diseases.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher

lines.en: And you studied conversion rates in chemical reactions for your paper?

lines.speaker: sakura_teen

lines.style: Steady, composed finish. No hesitation. Speaking with the same professional clarity as before, closing the exchange naturally.
